name: manual_e73571
claim: On a Mac with nvm, the Cline CLI can live under a non-default Node version tree and be absent from PATH, so a shell-based 'which cline' wrongly reports it uninstalled (this session wrongly told a peer it was not installed). Check ps and the nvm versions trees before claiming absence; fix by symlinking the binary into ~/.local/bin, which both PATH and the controller's discovery check. scripts/cline_autoresearcher.py _find_cline does not search nvm trees, so before the symlink the Mac ClinePass fallback failed closed as 'Cline unavailable'.
conditions: cline nvm PATH symlink discovery not-installed

decisions.notes: Observed 2026-11-10: binary under Node v24 tree, default Node v22; cline_available() False before the symlink, True after.

rationale: Observed 2026-11-10: binary under Node v24 tree, default Node v22; cline_available() False before the symlink, True after.
